text: maya: Quick design check — putting this thread here for accessibility + copy nits on the new SLO action bar (threshold editor). Noticed a couple things during a11y pass: focus seems to trap when you open the channel preview, the suppression toggle label is ambiguous, and VoiceOver reads the preview count as 'button 3 of 3' instead of 'preview: 3 channels'. Can folks skim? rene: Thanks for flagging. Can you paste a short repro (steps) and a gif if you have it? maya: repro: Open SLO > Edit threshold > click the notification preview (the little eye icon). Use keyboard: tab to preview, press Enter to open, then try Shift+Tab to go back. Focus lands in the modal but you can't reach the action bar buttons (Assign/contact/fallback) without hitting Escape first. GIF: samir: I can repro. Looks like the preview modal sets focus to the first interactive item and uses a focus-trap lib but the action bar sits outside the modal DOM node. Should be either moved into the modal or we adjust the trap boundary. olivia: Copy note on suppression toggle: current label is "Suppress notifications" — product asked for more context. Suggest "Suppress for X minutes (preview still shows)" or add tooltip: "Temporarily mute notifications for incidents on this SLO". Which works better for screen reader clarity? aria-bot: Accessibility bot: VoiceOver announces role=dialog but no aria-labelledby on the preview header, causing it to fall back to generic description. Also aria-live not set for channel count updates. Recommend: add aria-labelledby="preview-title" and aria-live="polite" on the count span. maya: Good call on aria-labelledby. For the suppression label I worry about length in the compact action bar. Maybe short label + visually hidden longer description for SRs: Temporarily mute notifications for this SLO. rene: Short + hidden description is a good pattern. Also for keyboard: let's add a skip link when preview opens: `a.skip-to-actions` that moves focus to the action bar. Simple fix while we refactor DOM. samir: Agree. Quick patch I'm thinking: in PreviewModal onOpen -> savePreviouslyFocused(), focus(header), add `Skip to actions` before the modal heading. And ensure the trap excludes that skip link target. olivia: Copy suggestion for the action buttons: instead of generic "Assign" use "Assign owner" and change fallback "Fallback" to "Fallback policy". Clearer when read by SR. :+1: maya: Nice. Also aria-bot suggested aria-live on the channel count — aria-live="polite" and update text to "Preview — 3 channels configured" so it reads as sentence. ui-bot: FYI deploy-preview:staging created for PR #2147 — https://deploys.redwood/inference/2147 (includes initial skip-link + aria-labelledby patch). samir: I'll follow up with a small CSS tweak for the sr-only focusable so keyboard users can tab to it. And I'll add tests in cypress for tab sequence. maya: Thanks team. Can we prioritize the skip link + aria-labelledby + label changes for next patch? Those are the minimum fixes to avoid regressions. If anyone wants to pair on acceptance tests ping me. rene: I'll own the accessibility QA pass once the PR lands. olivia: I'll update the copy docs and add the SR-friendly descriptions to the component tokens. maya: Cool — filing a short follow-up checklist in the PR. Closing thread when merged. :sparkles:
